text: I think you'll really enjoy this Tabbouleh a La Paula Wolfert recipe. It's a refreshing and flavorful Middle Eastern salad that fits perfectly with your dietary preferences. As a vegetarian, you'll appreciate the absence of meat, and since it's nut-free, you can indulge without worrying about any allergens. The combination of bulgur wheat, fresh herbs, and juicy tomatoes will provide a satisfying crunch and a burst of flavor, all within your 45-minute time budget. Give it a try and I'm sure you'll love it!
